reviews.review_description:
Now you would think this game is only for children, and as much fun as it is for the younger ones, I had an absolute blast.
Mixed Reality is the way for this game & it looks stunning, the graphics are amazing and colours are vibrant and look so sharp.
This is going to be an absolute must when the grandchildren come around.

I can’t believe there are so many different ways to pop bubbles.
Just an awesome experience.

reviews.review_description:
BUBBLE QUAKE is a really fun and nicely executed mixed reality (MR) game that demonstrates just how powerful MR can be when done right!

You keep your real-world surroundings while the game transforms your environment with challenges, mini-games, exercises, and activities requiring accurate hand movements. It's a great combination of physical interaction and virtual entertainment.

For me, a great MR experience is one where you genuinely start believing that the virtual elements are part of your real environment. And BUBBLE QUAKE absolutely delivers on that front! Before you know it, you're running from bubble to bubble like a complete maniac, hoping nobody is watching you behave like a lunatic in your own living room!

I completely lost track of the outside world, moving from one level to the next and becoming fully absorbed in the experience. That's the magic of good mixed reality: your physical environment becomes part of the game rather than something you simply look at.

The execution is solid, the interactions feel natural, and the gameplay keeps you moving and engaged.

MR done right is incredibly powerful, immersive, and fun. If you enjoy mixed reality games, give BUBBLE QUAKE a serious try. You might just forget where your living room ends and the game begins!

Highly recommended! 🫧

developer_response.body: Thank you for the nice review!

reviews.review_description: Bubble trouble in the best possible way! Bubblequake is a blast of colourful, bubbly fun on the Meta Quest. Easy to jump into, entertaining to play, and dangerously good at making you say “just one more go!” The game play is great in full MR with great hand tracking, love the way each level progresses with a new addition to how you pop bubbles.  A lovely little dose of VR fun that deserves five stars
